observations.value:
Replace:

> Make it good.

with a single observable completion gate:

> **Done when:** the artifact demonstrably achieves the skill’s stated first-principles outcome and no longer exhibits the skill’s named failure smells. If either condition cannot be verified from the artifact, continue revising or report the blocker.

Populate the outcome and smells from the skill’s existing first principles—not from the golden answers—and add no case-specific checklist, examples, or extra bulk.

Then:

1. Re-run all three cases, including the two that previously passed.
2. Use one fresh, context-free runner per case per run. Give each runner only its case input and the revised skill.
3. Isolate file-writing runs, then sweep the live checkout after every run and clean any leaks.
4. Have separate fresh judges grade each artifact using only the artifact, that case’s bar, and the skill’s first principles.
5. Run each case 2–3 times to account for nondeterminism and report pass rates.
6. If any case still fails, cite the artifact gap, diagnose it again, make only the failure-driven edit, and repeat the full three-case evaluation.
7. Report the before/after pass rates, the original “vague completion criterion” diagnosis, the exact replacement, and any remaining gaps.
